_comment: Faiths (pantheons) and the gods skills.json does not hold (prayer.js, Nate 18 Oct: 'survey all possible deities in Elder Scrolls lore and create religion selection based off of pantheon of a religion'; ~/claude-nate-release/for-local-claude-1018-pantheons.md). A character takes a faith, then a patron in it; they pray at any shrine of their faith's gods, their patron's answering more often. peoples are race editor id fragments: a suggestion for the picker, never a lock. Read at every load of prayer.js (hot reload).

deities.boon: Heavy Armor +10
deities.blessingPlan: SPEL 1D1FAA:DragonBreak Online Edits.esp (PC pantheons DLE 4cccdd6f (plinths), 19 Oct)
